_doc: Minecraft environment mode. manifest: written by tools/mc_extract.py from YOUR OWN Minecraft client jar (relative = from the project root; env MC_MANIFEST overrides). supportedShapes: block shapes the voxel renderer draws today (Phase 2 adds model/multipart shapes as it learns them). builtMobs: mobs the mob library (src/minecraft/mobs/models.ts) can draw; any other mob is a warning (drawn as a marker box). heights: body height in blocks for the inside-a-block check.
